question: Choose the most suitable option: I was __discussing about the issue with him.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence originally uses the phrase "discussing about the issue," which is incorrect because the word "discuss" does not require the preposition "about."
 
• The correct form is simply "discussing the issue," without the preposition.
 
• Option 3, "discussing the issue with him," is grammatically correct and concise.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I was discussing the issue with him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "discussed regarding the issue" – This phrase is incorrect because "regarding" is unnecessary here.
 
• **Option 2:** "had discussion on issue" – This phrase is incorrect because it lacks the article "the" before "issue."
 
• **Option 4:** "had been discussing about issue" – This phrase is incorrect because it uses "about" unnecessarily and also omits the article "the" before "issue."
